maya: quick Q — seeing schema/typing mismatches when using func/tool calling with typed SDK helpers. Model emits tool_call with arguments that are sometimes a quoted JSON string and sometimes raw object. Also streaming emits partial JSON chunks and our JSON.parse fails. Anyone seen this?

oliver: yep seen it. usually two problems: 1) model sometimes wraps JSON in backticks or text; 2) streaming splits objects across chunks. :face_with_raised_eyebrow: 

sunil: can you paste an example payload?

maya: here's a minimal JS snippet of the function call we get from the model:

maya: ```json
{"name":"create_ticket","arguments":"{\"title\":\"DB outage\",\"priority\":\"p1\"}"}
```

maya: note `arguments` is a string. SDK currently expects object and does `args = JSON.parse(call.arguments)` which fails when it's already an object or when it's partial during stream.

oliver: idea: SDK expose `coerce_tool_args(call)` that accepts string/object/stream and returns typed object or throws nice error. Should also attempt JSON.parse safely and handle wrapped text via regex.

jen: +1. also add streaming helper `collect_json_object(stream)` that accumulates until braces balanced (handles nested). Pseudocode:

jen: ```js
function collectJson(chunks){
  let buf=''; let depth=0; for (c of chunks){ buf+=c; for (ch of c){ if(ch=='{') depth++; if(ch=='}') depth--; }
  if(depth==0) return buf; }
}
```

sunil: edge case: model may send `}
some extra text` after object. We should strip trailing garbage after first balanced object. Also prefer using newline-delimited JSON if possible: ask model to emit ```json
{...}
``` or jsonl in system prompt.

maya: maybe SDK should add `parse_tool_call(call, {strip_wrappers:true, streamSafe:true})` helper and typings so users can do `const args = parse_tool_call(call) as CreateTicketArgs` — reduces boilerplate in apps.

oliver: agree. We'll draft a PR for `@redwood/sdk` with two helpers: `normalizeToolCall` + `streamJsonCollector`. I'll add tests for: string-wrapped args, raw object, partial stream, extra trailing text.

dev-bot: Created issue #3482 for SDK helpers: normalizeToolCall + streamJsonCollector (assigned to @oliver).

maya: thanks! assigning to me for review once PR lands. Also add docs snippet for prompts recommending `json` code fences.

jen: minor: ensure TypeScript definitions use `unknown` and then `zod` or `io-ts` for runtime validation, not `any`.

maya: yep, we'll include `safeParse` example with zod.

sunil: small perf note: don't buffer entire stream for very large arrays — allow streaming validation or early yield for arrays of items.

oliver: noted. will add streaming iterator option.

jen: cool, short-term patch ready today.
